name: episodic-online-s45
description: Evaluate persistent-memory SetJev by executing predictions in the independent test text environment; compare carry vs reset
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
MODEL=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/grouped_bce_4gpu_s44/v1/final
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
mkdir -p "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz"
cd "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish"
test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_qwen_s45/best.pt" && test -f "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data/test.jsonl" || { echo "missing head or held-out episodes"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/python" harness/eval_episodic_text_online.py --episodes "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data/test.jsonl" --head "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_qwen_s45/best.pt" --qwen-model "$MODEL" --model-identity BCE_S44_FINAL --device cuda --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_qwen_s45/online_eval.json" > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_online_s45.log" 2>&1
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
